author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: ctrl_q[3:0] is synchronized with depth 3 on bits 3:2 (s3_q) and depth 2 on bits 1:0, then reassembled in ctrl_o: CDC-032(a) ERROR (different chain depths, Async). CDC-009 is outside the CDC.md primary-finding order and may co-fire, but it fires identically on an equal-depth bundle, so it does not establish the seeded depth-skew defect; Reader B's CDC-009 addition rejected.

author_reading.rationale: A coherent 4-bit control bundle is synchronized with depth 2 on bits [1:0] and depth 3 on bits [3:2]: unequal chain depths.

labels.rationale: The four bits are launched as one word across asynchronous clocks. ctrl_o takes the upper bits after three destination cycles and the lower bits after two.

The 4-bit control bundle ctrl_q[3:0] (src_clk) is synchronized bit-by-bit into dst_clk without a Gray or handshake protocol (CDC-009), and its bits have mismatched synchronizer depths: bits [1:0] use 2 stages (s1_q[1:0] -> s2_q[1:0]) while bits [3:2] use 3 stages (s1_q[3:2] -> s2_q[3:2] -> s3_q[3:2] at design.sv:17), guaranteeing cycle-skewed bundle capture (CDC-032 ERROR Established).

settlement.rationale: ctrl_q[3:0] is synchronized with depth 3 on bits 3:2 (s3_q) and depth 2 on bits 1:0, then reassembled in ctrl_o: CDC-032(a) ERROR (different chain depths, Async). CDC-009 is outside the CDC.md primary-finding order and may co-fire, but it fires identically on an equal-depth bundle, so it does not establish the seeded depth-skew defect; Reader B's CDC-009 addition rejected.
